name: San Francisco
description: Weekly hyperlocal news, events and local business directories for San Francisco neighborhoods.

newsDesert.note: Not a news desert — SF retains several outlets. The pilot city, chosen for proximity rather than need.

name: Heber City
tagline: Local news for the Heber Valley, every Friday.
description: Weekly local news, events and a business directory for Heber City, Midway and the Heber Valley, Utah.

newsDesert.note: The Wasatch Wave published its final edition on 9 July 2025 after 136 years. Sister company Wave Printing closed 23 January 2026. Heber City has no paper of its own; Park Record (Park City) and KPCW (public radio) cover the valley from outside it.

name: Ellis County
tagline: Three editions for Ellis County, every Friday.
description: Weekly local news, events and a business directory for Waxahachie, Midlothian, Red Oak, Ennis and the towns of Ellis County, Texas.

newsDesert.note: Partial, and not uniform across the county. The Waxahachie Daily Light has published since 1867 and still exists as a weekly under CherryRoad Media, but its website carried nothing newer than 22 February 2026 when checked on 10 September 2026, and its circulation is roughly 1,100 in a county of 240,000. The Ennis News is a living weekly and covers Ennis, Ferris, Palmer, Italy and Rice properly. The real gap is north county: Midlothian and Red Oak have grown past 50,000 people between them with no paper of their own.
